_about: Public reviews of the team found on other sites. Nothing here is shown as a quotation: the review profiles are linked from each agent's page, and each review becomes a draft testimonial in WordPress that stays hidden until the client agrees to be quoted and REWAP approves. Review text is not copied here; paste the client's exact words into the testimonial once they agree. Found and counted 2026-11-06. Update 2026-11-16: the clients agreed to be quoted on this website and REWAP approved; Brandon's 12 reviews still on RateMyAgent were published as testimonials, word for word (taken from RateMyAgent and checked against it), each linked to its original review (url). The words live only in WordPress.
